title: Chance-constrained Flow Matching for High-Fidelity Constraint-aware Generation
abstract: arXiv:2509.25157v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative models excel at synthesizing high-fidelity samples from complex data distributions, but they often violate hard constraints arising from physical laws or task specifications. A common remedy is to project intermediate samples onto the feasible set at each sampling step. However, repeated projection can disrupt the learned sampling dynamics because this feasible set is defined for clean samples rather than noisy intermediate states. Thus, recent studies first estimate clean samples and then project them to the feasible set, but this increases algorithmic complexity and accumulates errors across steps. To address these issues, this paper proposes Chance-constrained Flow Matching (CCFM), a training-free method that formulates constraint enforcement during sampling as stochastic optimization while retaining the hard-constraint feasibility guarantee of projection-based methods. translated_title: 基于机会约束流匹配的高保真约束感知生成
translated_abstract: 生成式模型擅长从复杂的数据分布中合成高保真样本，但它们常常违反由物理定律或任务规范所产生的硬约束。一种常见的补救措施是在每个采样步骤将中间样本投影到可行集上。然而，重复投影可能会破坏模型已学习到的采样动态，因为该可行集是针对干净样本而非含噪的中间状态定义的。因此，近期的研究先估计干净样本，再将其投影到可行集上，但这会增加算法复杂度并跨步骤累积误差。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了机会约束流匹配，这是一种无需训练的方法，它将采样过程中的约束执行表述为随机优化问题，同时保留了基于投影方法的硬约束可行性保证，并避免了对含噪中间样本的直接投影。
tldr: 本文提出无需训练的机会约束流匹配（CCFM）方法，将采样过程中的约束执行表述为随机优化，在保留硬约束可行性保证的同时，避免了直接投影含噪中间样本所导致的采样动态破坏与误差累积问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Chance-constrained Flow Matching (CCFM), a training-free method that formulates constraint enforcement during sampling as stochastic optimization, retaining hard-constraint feasibility guarantees while avoiding the disruption of sampling dynamics and error accumulation caused by directly projecting noisy intermediate samples.
